maintenance_impact.evidence: Sampling policy, box encoding, decode, grayscale protection, resize and normalization constants are now double-owned; editing a still-healthy unit silently diverges from prefixed inline copies across three pipelines, so fixes repeat or training and evaluation drift unnoticed. Restoring single ownership across four central pipelines durably reduces mistaken edits, though no architecture boundary is redrawn.

development_plausibility.evidence: A believable misguided speed pass: per-image call-overhead rationale, hoisted alias lookups, guards folded into if/else, Chinese banner comments matching file style, and originals kept because prediction still calls them. Only the perfectly systematic prefix-renaming across all four sites leaves faint task-shaped regularity, short of indistinguishable evolution.

prompt_accuracy.evidence: Problem, cause, all four affected areas, finished state (delegating again, one maintained copy, not a rename), and preservation (seeded draw-order identity, public shape, txt output, helpers usable by every caller) match the diff and agree. Explicit anti-fork and anti-strand wording prevents incomplete cleanup and forking redesign while allowing new units at valid abstraction levels, a model contract.

semantic_diversity.evidence: Four distinct purposes: batch target construction, anchor generation with per-image proposal filtering, evaluation-time decoding with preprocessing, and dataset augmentation. Each needs a different code-supported decision: preserving interleaved subsampling draw order, keeping per-image mode-selected thresholds and padding draws, untangling rebound array-versus-tuple decode arguments, and restoring branch and default-parameter identity. No single repair rule spans the purposes.

localization_burden.evidence: The prompt names four areas, but classifying each block as a copy requires comparing bodies across components (trainer against creator units, forward against proposal and anchor units, callback against decode and image helpers), resolving local aliases plus prefixed renames that defeat textual search, and excluding healthy look-alikes, the untouched prediction flow that legitimately delegates to the same units.

repair_coordination.evidence: Repairs are largely independent per site, but shared rules span locations: every touched unit's meaning must stay identical for prediction and restored evaluation or training callers, and the proposal path's regenerated anchor tensor feeds the trainer's target construction with fixed dtype and shape; altering a shared unit at one site would silently break the other pipeline.

mechanical_resistance.evidence: The direct route of delegating back to the alias-pointed units fails as one rule because input types (numpy/torch/PIL), draw placement, guard ownership and the alias-less grid and coordinate-correction fragments differ per site; local extraction wraps bodies but leaves competing copies and cannot merge the two input-differing encodings. No decision-free rule reaches 20 percent of sites.

behavioral_risk.evidence: Several silent failure paths: reordering any subsampling or padding draw keeps training running but breaks seeded identity; dropping epsilon or empty-ground-truth guards fails only on degenerate inputs; omitting scale or normalization constants quietly shifts proposals and augmentation. The supplied material shows no test or execution record checking any of these; ordinary runs would pass.
